prompt:
You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH wins_per_team AS (
    SELECT 
        l.name as league_name,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t ON (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    GROUP BY l.name, t.team_long_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        l.name as league_name,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t ON (m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    GROUP BY l.name, t.team_long_name
),
combined_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_name,
        team_name,
        SUM(win_count) as total_wins
    FROM wins_per_team
    GROUP BY league_name, team_name
),
min_wins_per_league AS (
    SELECT 
        league_name,
        MIN(total_wins) as min_wins
    FROM combined_wins
    GROUP BY league_name
),
qualified_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        c.league_name,
        c.team_name,
        c.total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.league_name ORDER BY c.team_name) as rn
    FROM combined_wins c
    JOIN min_wins_per_league m ON c.league_name = m.league_name AND c.total_wins = m.min_wins
)
SELECT 
    league_name,
    team_name,
    total_wins
FROM qualified_teams
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league_name

WITH wins AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        l.name AS league_name,
        t.team_api_id,
        t.team_long_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal AND m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN 1
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal AND m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_win
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        league_name,
        team_api_id,
        team_long_name,
        SUM(is_win) AS total_wins
    FROM wins
    GROUP BY league_id, league_name, team_api_id, team_long_name
),
min_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        league_name,
        MIN(total_wins) AS min_wins
    FROM team_wins
    GROUP BY league_id, league_name
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        tw.league_id,
        tw.league_name,
        tw.team_api_id,
        tw.team_long_name,
        tw.total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tw.league_id ORDER BY tw.team_long_name) AS rn
    FROM team_wins tw
    JOIN min_wins mw ON tw.league_id = mw.league_id AND tw.total_wins = mw.min_wins
)
SELECT 
    league_name,
    team_long_name,
    total_wins
FROM ranked_teams
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league_name

    SELECT 
        league,
        CASE 
            WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN home_team
            WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN away_team
            ELSE NULL
        END AS winning_team
    FROM match_view
    WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
),
team_win_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        winning_team,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wins
    FROM team_wins
    WHERE winning_team IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY league, winning_team
),
min_wins_per_league AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        MIN(total_wins) AS min_wins
    FROM team_win_counts
    GROUP BY league
),
all_teams_with_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.league,
        tc.winning_team,
        tc.total_wins,
        mwl.min_wins
    FROM team_win_counts tc
    JOIN min_wins_per_league mwl ON tc.league = mwl.league
),
teams_with_min_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        winning_team,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league ORDER BY winning_team) AS rn
    FROM all_teams_with_wins
    WHERE total_wins = min_wins
)
SELECT 
    league,
    winning_team,
    total_wins
FROM teams_with_min_wins
WHERE rn = 1
